zoe: FYI i'm prototyping a lightweight "preview inspector" for automatic fallbacks. goal: let product + ops see a sampled view + clear audit link without flipping traffic. quick takes? :wave:
kevin: Nice. question: preview should be a replay of sampled traffic or run a simulation path? replay is higher fidelity but heavier.
leah: prefer replay of sampled, first_n_non_pii=3, redact PII. show a redaction shield on each sample.
sam: policy sketch (pseudo): { mode: "auto-fallback", trigger: {type: "latency_spike", thresh_ms: 1500}, scope: {routes: ["/chat"]}, preview_mode: "sample_replay", sample_n:3, handback_after_s: 600 }
ops-bot: Alert: preview inspector engaged for /chat at 2024-09-02T15:04:10Z (trigger_id=trg_p1).
ux-bot: UI idea: route row badge "preview->"; clicking opens inspector panel with: 1) 3 anonymized examples, 2) small metric delta card, 3) [Apply Live] (role-gated) and [Open Audit]. keyboard shortcut: ctrl+shift+p
security-bot: Note: capture defaults must redact tokens/emails. tenants can opt-out of sampling; record redaction=true in the audit event.
zoe: solid. next steps: kevin implement preview-sim endpoint + emit trigger_id, leah add redaction flag in sample schema, ux-bot mock inspector panel, i'll loop in privacy/legal on opt-out wording. reconvene tomorrow 10am. :thumbsup:
